name: I Can't Believe These Characters Are So Terrible!
source: Buff McManly is a jerk. He is mean to anyone and everyone, and will chase anything in a skirt, so what happens when he decides to throw an audition for random free-to-use characters? Laugh alongside him as he crushes the spirits of those who would try to impress him, give him odd looks as he makes questionable decisions, and nod your head in approval as he faces off against adversaries that would dare stand in his path of offensiveness!
translation: 巴夫·麦克曼利是个彻头彻尾的混蛋。他对谁都刻薄，只要穿裙子的就想追。那么，当他决定为随机选来的免费素材角色举行一场试镜时，会闹成什么样？看着他粉碎每一个试图讨好他的人的自尊，与他一同放声大笑；面对他一次次离谱的决定，向他投去异样目光；等他与胆敢挡在其冒犯之路上的敌手正面对决时，再满意地点头吧！
